title: Canonical derived residue pull square
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface]. Define S_T as exact restriction from residue to integral modules. The restriction/pullback isomorphism q_f:S_Y followed by integral f* ≅ residue f* followed by S_X is the ordinary restriction comparison transported through exact derived pullback. Let p_f be its inverse mate under the derived extension/restriction adjunctions. Every p_f is invertible. For all composable f:X→Y, g:Y→Z and every integral derived complex K on Z, reduction of the canonical pull-composition map followed by p_f and residue f* applied to p_g equals p_(fg) followed by the residue pull-composition map. Thus asIso(p_f) defines a coherent family c. Its scalar-counit identity is proved from the mates equivalence.

theorem integralResidue_pullSquare :
    (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y), IsIso (residueExchangePullHom ℓ E f)) ∧
      ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
        (K : residueExchangeDerived (integralCoeff ℓ E) Z),
        (residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X).map
            ((residueExchangeUpperStarComp (integralCoeff ℓ E) f g).hom.app K) ≫
          (residueExchangePullHom ℓ E f).app
            ((residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) g).obj K) ≫
          (residueExchangeUpperStar
            (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).map
            ((residueExchangePullHom ℓ E g).app K) =
        (residueExchangePullHom ℓ E (f ≫ g)).app K ≫
          (residueExchangeUpperStarComp
            (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f g).hom.app
            ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E Z).obj K)
